name: Prophecy
body:
School enchantment (compulsion) [mind-affecting]; Level oracle 2

CASTING

Casting Time 1 hour

EFFECT

Range same plane
Duration 1 day/level

DESCRIPTION

You foresee good fortune for one creature. As bless.
